bind.note: Default bind is loopback. Use a reverse proxy (nginx/caddy) on the VPS, or set KWIZERA_HOST=0.0.0.0 only when firewall and TLS are configured.

separation.applicationFiles: Git checkout / install directory (compiled dist + source UI/config)

flags.KWIZERA_FFMPEG_PATH: optional — required only for actual ffmpeg encoding, not for pipeline initialization

architecture.aiCore: original KWIZERA AI Core / Memory / Knowledge / Intelligence modules
architecture.externalProviders: optional (Ollama, OpenAI, ComfyUI, Automatic1111) — never required for startup

firstBoot.note: First start seeds KWIZERA Knowledge into KWIZERA_STORAGE_ROOT. Allow several minutes. systemd TimeoutStartSec should be at least 600.
